episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: I talk to Naja and then she and her mom talk.
No one is a prophet in her own home.
That's in a minute from Chicago Public Radio when our program continues.
Stay tuned for the following announcements and messages from our sponsors.
Support for This American Life comes from Columbia Pictures, presenting The Social Reckoning.

This electrifying thriller from Academy Award winner Aaron Sorkin is based on the true story of the Wall Street Journal reporter and the Facebook insider who took on the biggest social media company in the world.
Mikey Madison, Jeremy Allen White, and Jeremy Strong star in this timely David versus Goliath story about risking everything to tell the truth.
The social reckoning in theaters this Thursday.
